statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (u k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ)*t); let C (A : Set ℝ) (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) := intervalIntegral (A.indicator (fun t => (S n u t)^2 * E (-(n : ℝ)*t))) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let w (k : ℕ) := if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A → ‖C A n ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt - C A n w‖ ≤ e * (n : ℝ)

plain_statement.en: Uniform sublinear cost of removing proper prime powers on measurable frequency sets
plain_statement.zh: 在可测频率集上剔除真素数幂的一致次线性代价

brief.en: Only proper prime powers contribute to Λ − w. Bound their count by a base–exponent box and use the discrete ℓ² inequality.
brief.zh: Λ − w 仅支撑于真素数幂。用底数和指数的范围估计个数，再应用离散二范数界。
